verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic automation is a fair question for a SaaS HR/payroll platform, since such products can expose APIs or scriptable interfaces. The evidence, however, only describes UI click-paths (Pay > Make a Payment, Time Off > Policies). The only automation mentioned is a built-in Xero invoice auto-sync, which is not headless or CI operation. Probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.
